title: 30 Min Play Session at Timezone for 2500 Pts, 1 Bowling Game for 3000 Pts, Laser Tag 2000 Pts @ McDonald's / MyMacca's App
body:
Deal: 30 Min Play Session at Timezone for 2500 Pts, 1 Bowling Game for 3000 Pts, Laser Tag 2000 Pts @ McDonald's / MyMacca's App

[TheDukeOfNukem] Ripper, cheers OP. Just claimed a couple of the halfers, had a couple accounts around the 3k mark. Half an hour with the kiddos is about all I can handle at TimeZone lol.
Just remember, when you have those time cards, they let you fire up a new game every 60 seconds, so remember to tap your card again every minute you're on the same machine to get an extra life / go.
[justtoreply] I feel like you could use one Macca's account to get two codes, but then activate those codes to give two sessions in one day?
I'm new to this. Two kids.
[TheDukeOfNukem] Definitely can.
The way the TimeZone time card things work, you pay for half an hour, an hour, or some other amount of time I guess, but you pay for that, and you get the little tapper card like normal. It will work on all the normal games and stuff, and what will happen is
Tap to load a credit into the game
Wait 60 seconds to be elligible to load a credit again
That's the entire process of redemption.
Lets say you're on one of those three player shooting games. You can use the card to get one player going. 60 seconds later, it will work again and you can load in player two. Same goes in 60 seconds for player three. Once you get to that point, if you're still playing that game, you can use it to load extra lives and stuff for each player. So you could get two for both your kids, or you can squeeze it out and use those two for two full sessions. Really depends on what you value the most tbh.
You don't need to be stingy like this, but it's a good way to squeeze the maximum value out of it. One time I went in with my 10 year old and she was playing a couple of those silly little coin dozer things, I saw and ran to the Munsters pinball machine, loaded a credit on that. Loaded another credit. I uhh. I didn't die for a while. Before long between us there was a good probably half dozen credits loaded I just left on there for the next guy. There's been other times when we're in the last 5/10 of our hour and I make a point to tap it on anything she might jump to / is currently on. There's been times where we've paid for an hour, but as a result of selective scanning, we were playing for a good half hour after. Long lasting games like air hockey and the aforementioned pinball are a great way to maximize the time and money.
